decisions.reason: A cleaning soap is a cheap add-on that complements the core flooring range, so the option of keeping it open costs little while its value is still uncertain.
Maintenance oil fits the firm's oiled-floor surface treatments and needs little ongoing investment, so there is no evidence yet to justify abandoning it.
This care product partly overlaps with the soap and oil, but it is cheap to keep listed while it is unclear which care items customers will prefer.
An underlay with moisture protection is a functional accessory for installers and has low carrying costs, so the option stays open.
The high-density foam underlay is a low-cost range extension whose prospects are not yet resolved after one year, so it is kept.
Oak parquet is central to the firm's core business and established demand, so dropping it would forgo strategic value.
